Before you get started, please review and accept our terms.
By using Trevio, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
Trevio stores your name, email, and profile photo from your Google account. We use this to identify you and facilitate group expense splitting. Your data is stored securely in Firebase.
Trevio helps track expenses and settlements between users. We do not process actual payments. All settlements are tracked in-app. UPI deep links redirect you to your preferred payment app.
You are responsible for the expenses and settlements you add. Do not create fraudulent or misleading expense entries.
You can delete your account at any time. Upon deletion, your data will be removed from our servers.
